name: Ethiopia (Empire, 1897–1974)
description: A horizontal tricolor of green, yellow and red charged at the centre with the crowned Lion of Judah bearing a cross-staff with pennant.
history: The imperial flag of Ethiopia under Menelik II and Haile Selassie. Its green-yellow-red — the colours of the only African state to defeat colonization — inspired the pan-African colours adopted across the continent; the lion fell with the emperor in 1974.

features.symbolism: the Solomonic dynasty's 'Conquering Lion of the Tribe of Judah'
